note: Loup County and Taylor have countywide zoning (2021 regulations, district list AG/RC/AGR/R-1/C-1) with the zoning map published only as a PDF. The county's gWorks ArcGIS server (mapserver01.gworks.com/arcgis/rest/services/Loup_County_NE_Assessor) publishes only Parcels and Sections, with no zoning field and no zoning layer. The Zoning_Districts FeatureServer found in search is a different jurisdiction (1129 features, chapter-coded city ordinance), not Loup County.
